Maya R.: quick Q — my daycare just called, they're closed next week for emergency repairs and i'm booked to travel for two days of customer meetings. can i expense emergency childcare for those days? cost estimate ~$90/day.
Aisha (People Ops): sorry to hear that. childcare is treated as a personal expense by default, but we allow exceptions for last-minute closures if it would prevent you from attending a business-critical event and you get preapproval. :thinking_face:
Maya R.: what counts as proof for the closure?
Aisha (People Ops): typically we need a contemporaneous note from the provider (email/text screenshot) showing closure dates. if it's a family member caregiver, include a short note explaining availability. you also need manager sign-off before you book.
Jordan (manager): @Maya R. if those customer meetings are required, i can approve. please cc me on the preapproval email.
Maya R.: thanks — what's the exact preapproval process?
Aisha (People Ops): email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "Childcare preapproval - [Your name] [dates]". In the email attach: 1) travel confirmation (flight or hotel) 2) proof of daycare closure or caregiver note 3) quote/invoice or screenshot from the caregiver showing dates and rates 4) manager approval (DM screenshot or cc manager). We'll review within 48 business hours. Please do not book expecting reimbursement until you receive approval.
Maya R.: if approved, what receipts are needed when submitting the expense?
Aisha (People Ops): submit the paid, itemized invoice from the caregiver (must show provider name, dates, and amounts), proof of travel, the people-ops approval email, and your manager's approval. Expense category: "Other - Childcare (preapproved)".
FinanceBot: finance note: for payments made to an individual caregiver, we need a signed receipt with contact info. If total paid to a single contractor exceeds $600 in a calendar year, finance may request W-9 or local tax form.
Maya R.: is there a dollar cap if preapproved?
Aisha (People Ops): for emergency childcare we have a guideline cap of $100/day for up to 3 days for last-minute closures. higher amounts can be approved on a case-by-case basis with strong justification (e.g., meetings that cannot be rescheduled, customer escalation).
Maya R.: does this affect my per-diem or meal reimbursements?
Aisha (People Ops): no — childcare is separate and does not reduce per-diem or meal allowances.
Jordan (manager): i'm happy to approve up to $120/day for this trip given the customer meetings. Maya, cc me on the email.
Maya R.: filing preapproval now. appreciate the quick help! :raised_hands:
